originalTitle: Paleontological Discovery Unearths Exceptionally Preserved Feathered Dinosaur Specimen
originalContent: Paleontologists in East Asia have unearthed a pristine fossilized theropod specimen retaining microscopic melanosome structures within integumentary filaments. Chemical imaging confirmed pigment distributions that reveal vivid plumage patterns from the Early Cretaceous period. Evolutionary biologists note the find provides conclusive evidence regarding the biomechanics of avian flight evolution.
